factSources.text: Mars describes action, drive, heat, conflict, courage, desire, and the instinct to move toward what is wanted. It shows how someone fights, initiates, protects, reacts, and uses energy when something needs to happen. Mars takes close to two years to move through all twelve signs, with retrograde periods that slow or redirect momentum. Its sign describes the style of action; its house shows where pressure, effort, and courage become active. When Mars is in Cancer, your actions are motivated by emotion and intuition. You protect what you hold dear with a fierce determination. While you may approach situations cautiously, once you commit, you invest deep emotional energy.

eventsDuringTransit.meaning: Drive meets imagination. Energy steered by vision and a persuasive, magnetic pull. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Misdirected effort: setting off one way and ending up another, with energy quietly draining away. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

Drive meets limit. Disciplined endurance and the ability to pace yourself and keep going long after others quit. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Gas and brake at once: jerky, stop-start progress, frustration, and a need to avoid burning bridges in case of retreat. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.
